svg.aria-label: The axis of form and the axis of existence come apart: bibliographic surface structure is regular and sampled expertly, while whether the thing exists is an independent fact; the only interception point is checking existence
svg.text: The shell is complete; the core is empty

g.text: The axis of form models are expert at this one
author year journal volume pages identifier or case number court year
a highly regular surface structure, sampled without querying any database: perfect syntax, compliant format
The axis of existence the two do not entail each other
compliant format, the entity does not exist
the three are indistinguishable by appearance
The only interception point: check title and author against a real database
this step cannot be delegated to the model that generated it: sampling is not querying
The mechanism is conceptual and carries no fabrication rate: such figures must be bound to study, version and date.
The fabricated case names from that court matter are not listed here; the court's opinion lists them.
Filing fabricated citations under extrinsic hallucination is an explicit extrapolation from a source-bound task.
